english: You stand before a damp door, on a cramped corner house.
The wood is dark, swollen with the perpetual moist of Waterlane.
A layer of river mud and ALGAE.
...Why does that sound like a question?
You return to the damp door.
You rap your knuckles against the wood.
Then, the sound of a heavy latch sliding.
A pair of bulbous eyes stare up at you.
Dressed in a tiny, velvet smoking jacket.
Quite distinguished, despite the lack of pants.
He blinks slowly. A translucent membrane flicks across his eyes.
He starts to close the door.
Are you a... how do you say... le clergé?
More of a wizard, really. But sure.
I like to see myself as a dashing rogue, personally.
At least you are not from the tithe house.
I don't know the difference. I don't care, frankly.
A dashing...? Non. You are clearly a cleric.
Musique? I do fancy your human tunes at times...
He scoffs. A wet, croaking sound.
Hm. Do not touch my potted plants.
The anuran peeks his head out behind the door.
Ask for a contribution to your cause.
Why do you ask if I'm a cleric?
Look, buddy. Hand over some goods.
Is that all you wanted? To bother, and beg?
Because you smell of incense and self-righteousness.
Oh, so that's where they get it from.
Nothing you need to concern yourself with.
Gills. It's from your name, I assume.
That is idiotic. No. Don't ever say that again.
Is that a crime now? In this maudit city?
No. It is, as you say, shit.
Temporary. Until I take the next ship home.
He gestures vaguely to the port.
Just smile. The kind of smile that opens wallets.
Oh, and kiss his ass. Hard.
My good sir. Surely a gentleman of your stature supports the arts? Or the holy cause?
He sighs, his throat pouch inflating slightly.
He reaches for something on the other side of the door.
He shoves a fancy bottle towards you.
The door slams shut before you can say thank you, or anything else.
The pink-ish liquid inside swirls around.
This is no small potion. The anuran must be well-connected.
Lovely. This'll make things much smoother...
So you really just went and knocked on some stranger's door?
Look, I'm not gonna knock on your methods too much, but if you keep this up we'll be done by six months after the election.
And you didn't even ask about the tea shop. Not once.
I just had a feeling this door was important, was all.
I'm fairly certain I slipped one in there.
I'm fairly certain you did not slip anything, metaphorically or otherwise, into anyone.
The goblin closes his eyes in a short, silent contemplation.
Then he says, "Maybe stick to, uh, le points d'interest. Okay?"
